1: A skater in a black beanie and baggy plaid trousers pops an ollie, a boombox on one shoulder and a rock-on hand in the air.
2: A cosy reader in round glasses and a cable-knit sweater sits cross-legged on a tower of books, holding a hardback while a sleeping black cat curls up on their lap.
3: A curly-haired designer in dungarees hugs a paper coffee cup as tall as themselves, cheek on the lid, with a drawing tablet showing a bezier curve leaning at their feet.
4: A small gardener in a polka-dot bandana and rubber boots staggers along carrying a big pot with a monstera three times their height, a snail riding one of its leaves.
5: A film director in a beret and sunglasses, striped scarf flying, steps up onto an apple crate and shouts through a megaphone while holding a clapperboard aloft.
6: A trench-coated detective in a fedora creeps forward, one eye hugely magnified by an oversized magnifying glass, pinching a single striped sock as evidence.
7: A rug maker in goggles and dungarees kneels at a wooden frame, tongue out in concentration, punching yarn into a half-finished mushroom rug with a chunky tufting gun.
8: A monkey in a puffy spacesuit floats weightless, grinning inside the helmet and holding up a banana, its long tail ending in a tiny glove, a ringed planet nearby.
9: A dancer in headphones and an oversized track jacket laughs with eyes shut, ponytail whipping, balancing on one toe with the other leg kicked high.
